subject: GHE & JetBrains seat reallocation + SKU optimization plan
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orionlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Current seat footprint and renewal window

Ben —

Thanks for taking time during today's sync. Per our procurement team request, I'm attaching a CSV showing our active seat counts across teams (GHE and JetBrains). Our renewal window for GHE is 2027-03-15; JetBrains is 2027-04-01. We have a few immediate asks:

- Can Redwood provide options to pool or reassign GHE seats between engineering squads? Our org expects headcount changes in March.
- Are there SKU/discounts if we convert floating JetBrains seats to an all-in licensing bundle through your reseller?

Attachment: ghe_seat_inventory_20270218.csv (CSV)

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Platform Ops, Orion Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Current seat footprint and renewal window

Sophie —

Thanks — got the inventory. Looping Marissa (account lead) and Grace (technical PM for seat management) so we can propose a concrete plan. Quick thoughts up-front:

- GitHub Enterprise (GHE): we can support a temporary cross-team seat pool for 90 days to absorb headcount churn during hiring windows; that avoids immediate over-procurement. We'll need an authorized admin list from your side for seat transfers.
- JetBrains: partner Alex Duarte can run a SKU mapping to see if floating -> all-in saves >20% for your seat distribution. There are multi-year discounts if you commit to 12 months.

I'll draft a two-option proposal (conservative and cost-optimizing) and include estimated license spend and next steps for procurement. Plan to send by EOD Monday.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: two-option seat/sku proposal for Orion Labs

Team —

I've put together a compact plan (attached link) with two options:

Option A — Stability first
- Keep current seat counts; enable 90-day seat pool for GHE (audit every 30 days)
- Buy JetBrains floating license top-up for teams with immediate needs
- Estimated 12-month spend: $201,400

Option B — Cost optimize (recommended)
- Consolidate JetBrains licenses into partner-managed all-in SKU, reduce floating licenses by 35%
- Consolidate GHE seats with a 6-month pool + ability to purchase burst seats at negotiated unit price
- Estimated 12-month spend: $152,900 (projected 24% savings vs Option A)

Open items we need from Orion:
1) Verified admin emails for seat transfer authority
2) Preferred billing entity and PO template (Procurement asked for Redwood's standard fields)
3) Any compliance requirements for license residency (e.g., EU-only contractors)

Attachments: jetbrains_license_options_Q1_2027.pdf (PDF)
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/ghe-seat-sku-2027

Marissa
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orionlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: two-option seat/sku proposal for Orion Labs

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement prefers Option B (cost optimize) but needs three confirmations before issuing a PO:

- Final per-seat pricing for burst seats and the process for automatically provisioning them.
- Confirmation that seat transfers will leave an audit trail and monthly report.
- A template PO with Redwood's billing contact and tax details.

I'll get the authorized admin list by Wednesday. Also, Alex Duarte from JetBrains partner team asked to join a 30-min call to validate the SKU mapping — copying him in.

Sophie

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@orionlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@jetbrains-partner.com>, Procurement <procurement@orionlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft: two-option seat/sku proposal for Orion Labs

Forwarding the proposal for immediate action items —

Action items / next steps:
1) Alex (JetBrains partner): please confirm SKU equivalence and final list pricing by EOD Monday so we can lock Option B numbers.
2) Grace: please provide a one-page runbook for GHE seat pool operations (transfer workflow, audit log format, roles).
3) Sophie / Orion procurement: send PO template and the admin list by Wednesday.
4) Marissa: prepare contract addendum language (30- and 90-day pool clauses + burst pricing) to attach to renewal.

Attachments: procurement_template_PO-ORION-7842.docx (DOCX)

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
